# Vendored SEAL baseline

This directory is maintained as ordinary source code in the Inline-asm
repository. It is not a Git submodule.

- Upstream repository: `https://github.com/microsoft/SEAL.git`
- Upstream tag: `v4.4.4`
- Upstream commit: `96ae20db6649bc7c24e9a34994bedd70f4951f60`
- Local variant: `official-v4.4.4-baseline`

The upstream history is represented by the commit above. Changes made for the
HPU are tracked by subsequent Inline-asm commits. This project does not plan to
adapt the integration to newer SEAL releases.
